label: Product Staging
description: How the product is staged — the trending commercial vocabulary.

items.name: floating-hero
items.text: floating weightless as a hero shot, a soft elliptical shadow anchoring it to the set below

items.name: splash-freeze
items.text: in a frozen liquid splash, crown droplets suspended razor-sharp, every bead carrying its own highlight

items.name: podium-arch
items.text: on a matte podium before a sculpted arch backdrop, tone-on-tone plaster holding one soft gradient

items.name: fabric-drape
items.text: emerging from flowing silk caught mid-billow, folds spotlit into soft dunes around it

items.name: exploded-parts
items.text: exploded into its floating component parts, screws to shell in ordered ranks, shadows keeping formation below

items.name: monolith-shadow
items.text: beside a monolith casting one long graphic shadow, the product standing exactly at the light's edge

items.name: water-surface
items.text: standing in shallow reflective water, concentric ripples spreading to the set edges, its mirror image trembling

items.name: levitating-ingredients
items.text: orbited by levitating ingredients and raw material samples, each satellite in its own focus plane

items.name: color-block-set
items.text: in a color-blocked set of oversized geometric shapes, shadows doubling the composition in a second hue

items.name: spotlight-smoke
items.text: in a single spotlight beam through thin smoke, the cone of light made visible around it

items.name: mirror-infinity
items.text: on a mirror floor multiplying it into infinity, reflections dimming step by step into black

items.name: paper-gradient
items.text: on a seamless paper sweep, a soft two-tone gradient rolling from floor to infinity

items.name: gobo-shadow-play
items.text: under gobo shadow-play, palm-leaf patterns raking across product and backdrop in warm directional light

items.name: frozen-in-ice
items.text: cast inside a crystal-clear ice block, bubbles arrested mid-rise around the suspended product

items.name: dune-sand-set
items.text: on wind-rippled sand, one hard shadow line, grains sparking where the raking light grazes

items.name: moss-and-stone
items.text: on a moss-cushioned stone in a forest set, ferns dissolving softly behind, dew left intact

items.name: plinth-cluster
items.text: across a cluster of concrete plinths at stepped heights, each pedestal catching the light differently

items.name: wet-drench
items.text: drenched in a fresh spritz, droplets graded from fine mist to heavy beads down the body, one runnel breaking the pattern, the whole surface reading cold

items.name: knolling-flatlay
items.text: knolled in a strict overhead flat-lay, the product centered among its accessories at perfect right angles, shadowless even light, the gaps as deliberate as the objects

items.name: miniature-scale
items.text: staged as monumental architecture, tiny scale figures gathered at its base and a ladder leaning against it, depth of field selling the false size
